content:
Daniel Okafor-Reyes
Backend Software Engineer

Lisbon, Portugal | daniel.okafor-reyes@example.com | +351 555 010 202 | linkedin.com/in/daniel-okafor-reyes-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Backend engineer with 7 years of experience building and operating production services, primarily with Java and Spring. Experienced in REST API design, relational databases, Kafka event processing, automated testing, and cloud deployments on Kubernetes and AWS. Improved service performance and reliability through query tuning, caching, idempotent event handling, and production support.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages: Java (8–17), Kotlin (basic)
Backend and APIs: Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, REST, OpenAPI
Databases and messaging: PostgreSQL, Oracle, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ
Cloud and delivery: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, AWS (EKS, S3, SQS), Jenkins, CI/CD
Testing and tools: JUnit 5, Testcontainers, Git, Linux

WORK EXPERIENCE

Backend Engineer | Tejo Insurance Tech, Lisbon
Jan 2022–Present
- Develop and maintain 7 Java 17 / Spring Boot microservices supporting policy quoting and claims intake.
- Designed and versioned a REST API with OpenAPI for partner quoting integrations used by 12 broker partners.
- Build Kafka event producers and consumers for the claims workflow; introduced idempotent consumers and an outbox table, eliminating duplicate claim records.
- Reduced quote endpoint p99 latency from 1.8 seconds to 450 milliseconds by adding Redis caching and tuning JPA queries to address N+1 issues.
- Deploy services to Kubernetes (EKS) using Helm charts and Jenkins pipelines; participate in a monthly one-week on-call rotation.

Software Developer | Viajar Online S.A., Porto
Sep 2019–Dec 2021
- Built booking and payment features in a Java 11 / Spring MVC monolith backed by Oracle.
- Wrote integration tests with Testcontainers, increasing payments-module test coverage from 35% to 70%.
- Contributed to splitting the monolith by extracting the notifications service using Spring Boot and RabbitMQ.

Junior Developer (Internship, then Full-Time) | CodeFarol Lda, Porto
Jul 2018–Aug 2019
- Maintained PHP and later Java applications for small business clients.

EDUCATION
BSc Informatics Engineering | Atlantic Polytechnic Institute, 2018

LANGUAGES
English (fluent) | Portuguese (fluent) | Spanish (conversational)

critique.content_quality_feedback: The CV is clear, concise, professionally structured, and strongly evidence-based. It presents relevant backend experience with quantified outcomes, including a reduction in p99 latency from 1.8 seconds to 450 milliseconds and increased test coverage from 35% to 70%. The experience bullets are action-oriented and demonstrate production ownership, event-driven systems, API design, reliability work, cloud deployment, and on-call participation. The main content limitation is that some relevant capabilities are listed only in the Skills section rather than explicitly connected to work experience, particularly PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS, CI/CD, and automated testing. The document also does not directly explain the candidate's fit for a Python role, although it accurately presents Java as the candidate's comparable backend language.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: The CV uses ATS-friendly headings, standard chronological formatting, plain text contact details, conventional date ranges, and recognizable technology keywords. It should parse well and has a high AI/ATS screening probability for the comparable-language version of the role because it includes Java, Spring Boot, REST, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS, Kubernetes/EKS, Kafka, automated testing tools, Jenkins, and CI/CD. Exact Python/FastAPI matching will be weaker because neither Python nor FastAPI appears in the candidate information and must not be added. The keyword coverage for schema migrations, observability, Terraform, GitHub Actions, EDI, and logistics is absent, but these are candidate experience gaps rather than CV defects. The use of an en dash in Java version ranges is generally acceptable, though standard hyphens can marginally improve parsing consistency.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: Alignment is strong for the comparable-language interpretation of the role. The CV shows 7+ years of backend development in Java, REST API design and versioning, relational database work, query tuning, Kafka event processing, Docker, AWS EKS deployment, Kubernetes, automated integration testing, Jenkins pipelines, and production on-call responsibility. It also demonstrates reliability improvements and ownership of production services, which fit the company's dependable engineering and service-ownership culture. The candidate's experience with idempotent consumers, an outbox table, caching, N+1 query remediation, and API performance is particularly relevant to shipment-event ingestion and tracking-platform reliability. The document does not show Python/FastAPI experience, safe live schema migrations, observability tooling, Terraform, logistics or EDI knowledge, Dutch/French, GitHub Actions, post-mortems, or design notes. These are gaps in the candidate material or unsubstantiated requirements, not defects to be repaired by rewriting. The CV does show fluent English, but it does not explicitly demonstrate explaining technical trade-offs or documenting architecture decisions.
critique.improvement_instructions:
MINOR ENHANCEMENT 1 — In the Professional Summary, make the comparable-language fit more explicit without claiming Python experience. Replace the opening sentence with: "Backend engineer with 7 years of experience designing, building, and operating production backend services in Java and Spring Boot, a comparable language and framework stack for backend development." Keep the existing REST, relational database, Kafka, Kubernetes, AWS, testing, and reliability evidence in the remaining sentences.

MINOR ENHANCEMENT 2 — In the Technical Skills section, retain the existing "Cloud and delivery" line but change it to: "Cloud, containers and delivery: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, AWS (EKS, S3, SQS), Jenkins, CI/CD". This makes the CI/CD keyword explicit while remaining supported by the original information's Jenkins pipeline experience.

MINOR ENHANCEMENT 3 — In the Tejo Insurance Tech experience section, revise the deployment bullet to connect the listed technologies and delivery practice more directly to the job wording: "Deploy Java/Spring Boot services to AWS EKS with Docker, Helm charts, and Jenkins CI/CD pipelines; participate in a monthly one-week on-call rotation." Use this only if Docker is part of the deployment process as represented in the candidate's existing skills; otherwise keep the current wording and do not imply a deployment detail not confirmed in the source information.

MINOR ENHANCEMENT 4 — In the Viajar Online S.A. experience section, revise the testing bullet to include the ATS-relevant term already supported by the evidence: "Wrote automated integration tests with Testcontainers, increasing payments-module test coverage from 35% to 70%."
